description: This source file defines a Logger utility class that provides logging functionalities, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log class. It includes methods for various log levels, managing a chain of LogNodes, and provides standard logging methods with additional static configuration.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class for logging that forwards log messages to a chain of LogNodes, providing convenience methods for different log levels and managing the chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode chain to which log messages are sent.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain which will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message with VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message with DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message with INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message with WARN priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message with ASSERT priority.
